node.statement: Assume the antecedent of the corrected node: every coordinate system belonging to A is allowable in the Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead sense. For any chart (U,phi) in A, universal instantiation of that antecedent says that (U,phi) is allowable; by the meaning of domain, U is therefore the domain of an allowable coordinate system. Since the chart was arbitrary, this proves the first sentence of node 1.1.3. This is deliberately conditional and asserts no existence of such an atlas.
